## About
Glenville Terrace Auto Body is part of a family owned and operated business. The Hynes family has been building trust in its car repair services and adding locations, and Barry Hynes brings that experience and reputation to our shop on Glenville Terrace, between Parkvale Ave and Harvard Ave in Allston.
We do first class body, paint and repair work, insurance claim repairs, and full maintenance services. Our I-CAR and ASE-certified technicians stand behind their work, and we restore your paint to its pre loss condition using the same process manufacturers require.
When you call or stop in, you'll deal with people like Emer, our office manager, Danny, our mechanical supervisor, and Rodrigo and Steve, who manage the body side. Our staff speaks several languages common to the Allston community.
We hold a 4.7 rating from 351 Google reviews. One reviewer came in for a second opinion on some deep scratches and wrote that Viet buffed them out and wouldn't charge her a thing. Another said his car was ready well before he was told it would be.

## Services
- First class body, paint and repair work: Collision and body repair for your car, from dents and damage to the finish.
- Paint: We will restore your vehicle's paint to the pre loss condition.
- Tune ups: Regular tune ups as part of our complete auto maintenance services.
- Oil filter and lubrication: Oil, filter and lubrication service to keep your engine running right.
- Brakes: Brake work done by the same team that handles your body and maintenance repairs.
- Front-end alignment: Front-end alignment along with shocks, exhaust, suspension and transmission work.
- Diagnostics: We track down what's wrong before we fix it.

## FAQ
Q: Do you charge for a consultation?
A: No. We offer free consultation and appointments, and we're open 6 days a week.

Q: Will you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We're a preferred referral shop for most insurance companies in Massachusetts.

Q: Can I wait, or get a loaner?
A: You can wait in our new waiting room office with facilities and TV, or arrange for a loaner car.

Q: How can I pay?
A: We accept MasterCard, Discover, Visa, American Express and Travelers Check, as well as payment by check.

Q: How do I get to the shop?
A: Come by car or the Green Line T. We're on Glenville Terrace in Allston.
